detached_structure.evidence: Within the outline, east of the main house, there is a gabled or hipped structure partly under trees, with an adjacent white lattice pergola-like feature; it may be an attached addition or garden structure.

signals.notes: Heavy mature tree canopy covers the north and east portions of the lot, a white lattice pergola or porch sits at the south of the house, and the driveway or walkway at the lower left is empty.
